simple.prompt: Relative pronoun with prepositions (formal): 'The executive ___ whom I reported was transferred to Geneva.'
simple.explanation: Dalam ragam formal (pied-piping), preposisi diletakkan di depan 'whom': 'to whom I reported'.

simple.prompt: Sentential relative clause: 'She completed the marathon in under three hours, ___ astonished everyone.'
simple.explanation: Sentential relative clause merujuk pada SELURUH klausa sebelumnya, dan WAJIB menggunakan 'which' (didahului koma). 'That' tidak boleh dipakai.
hints: Merujuk pada seluruh isi kalimat sebelumnya.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat dengan sentential relative clause.
simple.targetSentence: He forgot his passport which caused a serious delay.
simple.explanation: He forgot his passport + which caused a serious delay.
hints: Sentential relative clause: 'which caused a serious delay'.

simple.prompt: Quantifier + of which / of whom: 'The university received two hundred applications, thirty ___ were from international scholars.'
simple.explanation: Untuk merujuk pada benda/dokumen ('applications'), gunakan 'of which' ('thirty of which were...').

simple.targetSentence: She interviewed ten candidates all of whom were highly qualified.
simple.explanation: She interviewed ten candidates + all of whom were highly qualified.
hints: Lanjutkan dengan 'all of whom were highly qualified'.

simple.prompt: Possessive relative pronoun: 'We visited a startup ___ founders were alumni of Stanford.'
simple.explanation: 'Whose' digunakan untuk kepemilikan orang maupun organisasi/entitas: 'whose founders were...'.

simple.targetSentence: This is the era in which technological disruption accelerates.
simple.explanation: This is the era + in which technological disruption accelerates.
hints: Klausa formal: 'in which technological disruption accelerates'.

simple.prompt: The regional coordinator ___ whom we submitted our expense summary works in Singapore.
simple.explanation: Dalam gaya formal setelah verb 'submit [something] to [someone]', preposisi 'to' diletakkan di depan relative pronoun objek manusia 'whom' ('to whom').

simple.prompt: Our ferry was delayed by dense morning fog, ___ meant we missed the opening workshop.
simple.explanation: Sentential relative clause yang merujuk kembali pada seluruh kejadian di klausa sebelumnya setelah koma WAJIB menggunakan ', which' (tidak boleh 'that' atau 'what').
hints: Merujuk ke seluruh fakta penundaan kapal feri sebelumnya.

simple.prompt: The laboratory ordered fifteen laptops, several of ___ still need specialized calibration tools.
simple.explanation: Untuk menghubungkan klausa kedua dengan koma pada benda ('laptops'), konstruksi quantifier + relative pronoun memakai 'several of which' (bukan 'several of them').
hints: 'Laptops' adalah benda mati, dan hanya dipisah koma.

simple.prompt: Is that the marine biologist ___ underwater documentary won an international jury award?
simple.explanation: Menunjukkan kepemilikan ('dokumenter bawah air MILIK ahli biologi itu') memakai possessive relative pronoun 'whose' sebelum noun 'underwater documentary'.
hints: Ada kata benda 'underwater documentary' langsung setelahnya.

simple.prompt: Lengkapi percakapan formal tentang dokumen referensi ('by which').
dialogue: Could you clarify the calculation method ___ your branch prices freight routes?
Certainly — we use a distance-weight formula documented in Appendix B.
simple.explanation: Preposisi 'by' ('price routes BY this method') yang dipindah ke depan relative pronoun benda menghasilkan 'by which' (tidak pernah 'by that').
hints: Preposisi di depan relative benda memakai 'by which'.

simple.prompt: The research institute, ___ headquarters are located in Delft, partners with coastal cities globally.
simple.explanation: Kepemilikan oleh institusi/benda ('the institute's headquarters') juga menggunakan 'whose' sebelum kata benda 'headquarters'.

simple.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan mengganti 'which' dengan 'that' setelah koma pada sentential relative berikut.
simple.draft: The vendor shipped the spare sensors ahead of schedule, that saved our assembly line two full days.
options: The vendor shipped the spare sensors ahead of schedule, which saved our assembly line two full days.
The vendor shipped the spare sensors ahead of schedule, what saved our assembly line two full days.
The vendor shipped the spare sensors ahead of schedule, whom saved our assembly line two full days.
simple.explanation: Sentential relative clause setelah tanda koma TIDAK PERNAH boleh diawali 'that' maupun 'what'; wajib gunakan 'which'.
hints: Ada koma di depan klausa penjelas keseluruhan kalimat.

simple.prompt: All twenty interns completed the security quiz, most of ___ scored above ninety percent.
simple.explanation: Karena 'interns' adalah manusia dan didahului preposisi 'of' ('most of...'), bentuk formal mewajibkan 'whom' dalam satu kalimat berkoma.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat memakai sentential relative ', which'.
simple.targetSentence: The coastal train switched to clean solar power, which cut emissions sharply.
simple.explanation: Koma + 'which' merujuk ke seluruh pernyataan tentang peralihan kereta ke tenaga surya.
hints: Awali dengan 'The coastal train switched to clean solar power,'.

simple.targetSentence: This is the regional grant for which our robotics club applied last October.
simple.explanation: Preposisi 'for' dari frasa 'applied for' dipindahkan ke depan 'which' agar bergaya formal.
hints: Mulai dengan 'This is the regional grant for which'.
Tambahkan 'our robotics club applied last October'.

intermediate.prompt: Lengkapi dialog formal diplomatik dengan prepositional relative clause.
dialogue: Which framework will guide the upcoming maritime negotiations?
The 1982 convention, under the provisions ___ both nations operate.
intermediate.explanation: 'Under the provisions of which' (di bawah ketentuan konvensi tersebut).

intermediate.prompt: Reduced relative clauses: 'The proposal ___ by the financial committee will be discussed tomorrow.'
intermediate.explanation: Reduced passive relative clause: 'The proposal tabled...' (= which was tabled).

intermediate.prompt: Nominal relative clause with 'what': 'You should focus on ___ truly matters for your long-term career.'
intermediate.explanation: Nominal relative clause: 'what' = 'the thing that/which': 'focus on what truly matters'.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat dengan quantifier 'none of which'.
intermediate.targetSentence: He offered three different explanations none of which sounded convincing.
intermediate.explanation: He offered three different explanations + none of which sounded convincing.
hints: Mulai dengan 'He offered three different explanations'.
Quantifier negatif: 'none of which sounded convincing'.

intermediate.prompt: Whomever / Whoever: 'We will award the research grant to ___ presents the most compelling methodology.'
intermediate.explanation: Di dalam klausa nomina, 'whoever' berfungsi sebagai subjek kata kerja 'presents': 'to whoever presents...'.

intermediate.targetSentence: You may choose whatever suits your personal learning style.
intermediate.explanation: You may choose + whatever suits your personal learning style.
hints: Nominal clause: 'whatever suits your personal learning style'.

dialogue: Are all contractors subject to the non-disclosure terms?
Yes, including those ___ external consulting agencies.
intermediate.explanation: Reduced active relative clause: 'those representing external consulting agencies' (= those who represent).

intermediate.prompt: Choose the sentence using a COMPLEX prepositional phrase inside a relative clause cleanly:
options: They signed a bilateral agreement, in accordance with which all customs tariffs were lowered.
They signed a bilateral agreement, in accordance with that all customs tariffs were lowered.
They signed a bilateral agreement, in accordance with what all customs tariffs were lowered.
intermediate.explanation: Dalam gaya hukum/diplomatik, frasa preposisi kompleks ('in accordance with', 'by means of', 'as a result of') selalu berpasangan dengan 'which' (bukan 'that' atau 'what').
hints: Setelah preposisi kompleks formal, gunakan 'which' (benda) atau 'whom' (orang).

intermediate.prompt: The compliance regulations ___ next January will require clearer ingredient labels on imported snacks.
intermediate.explanation: Reduced active relative clause dari 'which take effect' (berlaku secara aktif) diringkas menjadi present participle '-ing' ('taking effect').

intermediate.prompt: Lengkapi percakapan membedakan preposisi formal (pied-piping) vs percakapan alami (preposition stranding).
dialogue: In casual speech we ask 'The colleague I spoke with was helpful.' How do you elevate that into formal legal prose?
options: The colleague with whom I spoke was helpful.
The colleague with who I spoke was helpful.
The colleague with that I spoke was helpful.
intermediate.explanation: Memindahkan preposisi ke depan relative pronoun disebut pied-piping: wajib menggunakan 'whom' untuk orang ('with whom I spoke'), bukan 'who' atau 'that'.
hints: Setelah preposisi 'with', pronoun orang wajib memakai 'whom'.
Pastikan preposisi 'with' tidak muncul ganda di akhir.

intermediate.prompt: Please forward this priority access link to ___ will oversee the Saturday registration desk.
intermediate.explanation: Hati-hati! Walaupun ada 'to' di depan, pronoun tersebut bertindak sebagai SUBJEK bagi kata kerja 'will oversee' di dalam klausanya sendiri, sehingga wajib memakai bentuk subjek: 'whoever'!
hints: Tentukan peran kata ganti di dalam klausanya sendiri: '... will oversee'.

intermediate.prompt: ___ surprised the urban planners most was how quickly commuters adopted the bicycle lanes.
intermediate.explanation: Nominal relative pronoun 'What' (= 'The thing that') dapat langsung menjadi klausa subjek tanpa antecedent sebelumnya.
hints: Tidak ada kata benda sebelum rumpang.
'What' berarti 'hal yang...' dan dapat mengawali subjek kalimat.

intermediate.prompt: Sunting kesalahan umum menyertakan preposisi ganda (di depan dan di belakang sekaligus) berikut.
intermediate.draft: The architectural committee reviewed the criteria upon which the finalists would be judged on.
options: The architectural committee reviewed the criteria upon which the finalists would be judged.
The architectural committee reviewed the criteria upon that the finalists would be judged.
The architectural committee reviewed the criteria which the finalists would be judged upon it.
intermediate.explanation: Apabila preposisi ('upon') sudah dipindahkan ke depan 'which' ('upon which...'), hapus pengulangan preposisi ('on') di ujung kalimat.
hints: Preposisi tidak boleh muncul dua kali (di depan 'which' dan di akhir klausa).

intermediate.prompt: The manuscript contained three untranslated footnotes, none of ___ seemed critical to the main thesis.
intermediate.explanation: Partitif negatif setelah koma ('none of...') untuk benda ('footnotes') menggunakan 'which' dalam satu kalimat.

intermediate.prompt: Every medical device ___ at the municipal clinic undergoes calibration twice a year.
intermediate.explanation: Reduced passive relative clause ('which is operated at the clinic') cukup menyisakan past participle V3 'operated'.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat memakai 'whoever' sebagai subjek klausa objek preposisi.
intermediate.targetSentence: Management will award a travel stipend to whoever submits the winning design.
intermediate.explanation: Karena menjadi subjek dari 'submits', gunakan 'whoever' meski didahului preposisi 'to'.
hints: Awali dengan 'Management will award a travel stipend to'.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat formal memakai frasa preposisi kompleks + 'which'.
intermediate.targetSentence: They revised the charter, on the basis of which local cooperatives gained voting power.
intermediate.explanation: Frasa 'on the basis of which' mengacu kembali ke 'the charter'.
hints: Sambungkan 'on the basis of which local cooperatives gained voting power'.

complex.prompt: Koreksi penggunaan 'what' yang keliru menggantikan sentential 'which'.
complex.draft: The inflation rate dropped to 2.1 percent, what was welcomed by the stock exchange.
options: The inflation rate dropped to 2.1 percent, which was welcomed by the stock exchange.
The inflation rate dropped to 2.1 percent, that was welcomed by the stock exchange.
The inflation rate dropped to 2.1 percent, where was welcomed by the stock exchange.
complex.explanation: 'What' tidak bisa digunakan sebagai relative pronoun yang merujuk pada klausa sebelumnya. Sentential relative clause WAJIB menggunakan 'which' (didahului koma).
hints: Klausa penjelas kalimat sebelumnya harus memakai 'which'.

complex.prompt: Pied-piping vs Preposition Stranding: Compare (1) 'The topic about which we spoke' and (2) 'The topic we spoke about'. Which register consideration applies?
options: (1) is formal/academic (pied-piping); (2) is standard contemporary/informal (preposition stranding).
(2) is only permitted in legal contracts.
complex.explanation: Pied-piping (menaruh preposisi di depan pronoun 'about which') adalah konvensi tulisan formal/akademik, sedangkan penempatan preposisi di akhir (stranding) lazim pada ragam netral/percakapan.
hints: Pilih opsi pied-piping formal vs stranding informal.

complex.prompt: Double prepositional relative structure: 'The treaty, ___ both signatories had committed significant diplomatic capital, was finally ratified.'
complex.explanation: Frasa formal kompleks: 'to the success of which both signatories had committed...'.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat akademik dengan 'the extent to which'.
complex.targetSentence: Scholars debate the extent to which environment influences cognitive development.
complex.explanation: Scholars debate the extent to which + environment influences cognitive development.
hints: Mulai dengan 'Scholars debate the extent to which'.

complex.prompt: Koreksi koma pada defining relative clause.
complex.draft: The employees, who work in the finance department, are eligible for the bonus.
options: The employees who work in the finance department are eligible for the bonus.
The employees that work in the finance department, are eligible for the bonus.
The employees, that work in the finance department, are eligible for the bonus.
complex.explanation: Jika informasi bersifat esensial/pembeda (hanya karyawan divisi finance yang berhak bonus, bukan semua karyawan), kalimat tersebut adalah Defining Relative Clause dan TIDAK BOLEH diapit koma.
hints: Hapus tanda koma di sekitar klausa.

complex.prompt: Relative clauses with 'whereby': 'The organization established a mentoring scheme ___ senior executives coach junior staff.'
complex.explanation: 'Whereby' adalah relative adverb formal yang berarti 'by which' (yang melaluinya / dengan cara mana mekanisme itu berjalan).

dialogue: How does the supreme court interpret this statutory clause?
As an instrument ___ individual liberties are rigorously defended.
complex.explanation: 'Whereby' digunakan dalam teks hukum untuk menyatakan sarana atau mekanisme hukum perlindungan.

complex.prompt: Now contrast 'whoever' vs 'whomever': 'The committee is authorized to consult ___ the project lead recommends for the audit.'
complex.explanation: Di sini, 'the project lead' sudah menjadi subjek dan kata ganti tersebut berfungsi sebagai OBJEK dari verb 'recommends' ('recommends him/her'), sehingga bentuk formalnya adalah 'whomever'.
hints: Uji klausa kedua: 'the project lead recommends [him/her]'.
Fungsi sebagai objek dalam klausanya sendiri memakai 'whomever'.

complex.prompt: In formal prose, 'the era during which', 'the extent to which', or 'the precision with which' uses relative adverbs/prepositional phrases cleanly: 'The clarity ___ she explained complex tax treaties impressed the panel.'
complex.explanation: Kolokasi kata benda-preposisi yang tepat adalah 'clarity WITH which' (berasal dari 'explained treaties WITH clarity').
hints: Cocokkan preposisi bawaan dari 'clarity': 'explain with clarity'.

complex.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan pemilihan 'where' vs 'which' saat klausa mengacu pada tempat sebagai OBJEK langsung (bukan lokasi kejadian) berikut.
complex.draft: This is the historic railway terminal where the municipal government plans to restore next autumn.
options: This is the historic railway terminal which the municipal government plans to restore next autumn.
This is the historic railway terminal in where the municipal government plans to restore next autumn.
This is the historic railway terminal whereby the municipal government plans to restore next autumn.
complex.explanation: 'Restore' adalah verb transitif yang memerlukan objek langsung ('restore THE TERMINAL', bukan 'restore IN the terminal')! Karena terminal adalah objek langsung, wajib memakai 'which/that', bukan 'where'.
hints: Tanyakan: 'restore the terminal' atau 'restore AT the terminal'?

complex.prompt: Lengkapi percakapan akademik tentang relative adverb formal 'whereby'.
dialogue: We need a concise formal connector for 'They introduced a system through which farmers share weather alerts.' Any ideas?
Replace 'through which' with the formal relative adverb ___.
complex.explanation: Dalam teks hukum, kebijakan, dan akademik formal, 'whereby' (= by which / through which) merujuk pada mekanisme, sistem, perjanjian, atau proses kerja.
hints: 'Whereby' berarti 'yang melaluinya / berdasarkan mana' untuk suatu sistem atau aturan.

complex.prompt: The new municipal bond initiative, ___ details were finalized yesterday, aims to fund green ferries.
complex.explanation: Ketika kata benda kepemilikannya langsung mengikuti rumpang tanpa article 'the' ('___ details were finalized'), gunakan determiner posesif 'whose' (untuk 'of which', susunannya harus 'the details of which').
hints: Perhatikan tidak ada article 'the' di depan kata benda 'details'.
Posisi determiner langsung sebelum noun memakai 'whose'.

complex.prompt: Compare carefully: 'We drafted a backup plan, the complexity of ___ forced us to delay training.'
complex.explanation: Dalam pola formal kepemilikan benda 'the + noun + of + which' ('the complexity of which'), hanya 'which' yang gramatikal di dalam relative clause berkoma.

complex.prompt: Sunting kesalahan menyatukan klausa relatif non-defining menjadi defining yang mengubah fakta geografis berikut.
complex.draft: Jakarta which is Indonesia's largest metropolitan hub hosts dozens of regional fintech startups.
options: Jakarta, which is Indonesia's largest metropolitan hub, hosts dozens of regional fintech startups.
Jakarta that is Indonesia's largest metropolitan hub hosts dozens of regional fintech startups.
Jakarta, that is Indonesia's largest metropolitan hub, hosts dozens of regional fintech startups.
complex.explanation: Karena 'Jakarta' adalah nama diri unik yang sudah teridentifikasi penuh (hanya ada satu Jakarta), klausa penjelasnya wajib bersifat NON-DEFINING dan diapit dua koma (', which...,') serta tidak boleh memakai 'that'.
hints: Nama diri unik seperti nama kota selalu memakai koma (non-defining).
Apit klausa dengan dua koma dan pertahankan 'which'.

complex.prompt: The extent ___ microplastics enter deep-sea food webs remains an active field of study.
complex.explanation: Kolokasi akademis baku untuk kata 'extent' atau 'degree' adalah 'the extent TO which...' ('sampai sejauh mana').
hints: Ungkapan baku akademis: 'the extent to which...'.

complex.targetSentence: The cooperative launched a microloan scheme whereby artisans purchase looms interest-free.
complex.explanation: 'Whereby' (= through which) menghubungkan 'a microloan scheme' dengan mekanisme pelaksanaannya.
hints: Awali dengan 'The cooperative launched a microloan scheme whereby'.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat formal dengan 'the [noun] of which' untuk kepemilikan benda.
complex.targetSentence: The committee inspected a prototype, the outer casing of which was milled from recycled aluminum.
complex.explanation: 'The outer casing of which' setara dengan 'whose outer casing' dalam ragam teknik/akademis.
hints: Mulai dengan 'The committee inspected a prototype,'.
Tambahkan 'the outer casing of which was milled from recycled aluminum'.
